name: Al Maajid
description: This name shares with Al Majeed the meaning of glory, nobility and generosity; it does not denote an unrelated attribute.
summary: Al Maajid expresses glory, nobility and generosity, sharing its meaning with Al Majeed. The words are distinct Arabic forms. Quran 11:73 contains Majeed, so it supports the related meaning rather than being a literal occurrence of Maajid.
